switchAsic.description: 102.4 Tb/s switching capacity, 16 × 6.4T Davisson DR optical engines, 200 Gb/s per link, field-replaceable ELSFP laser modules. Broadcom lists IEEE 802.3 interoperability with existing 400G/800G standards and scale-up support up to 512 XPUs; current lifecycle is Limited Release. OCP Global Summit 2026: demonstrated with Celestica, Delta Electronics and Micas Networks as a 102.4T CPO solution; partner showcase confirms demonstration, not shipment availability.
